source.stem:
The structures of four molecules are shown.

Which molecules belong to the same homologous series?

intelligence.enrichment: Anything that occupies space and has mass is called matter. Mass and volume are properties possessed by all materials, and materials are types of matter used in making objects. has mass plus occupies space -> identified as matter The learner correctly applies this rule: Anything that occupies space and has mass is called matter. Mass and volume are properties possessed by all materials, and materials are types of matter used in making objects. Only things that can be seen are matter, so air is not matter.
